Monica — forwarding Gridly's packet. They asked for a provisional procurement reference to start a pilot. Requested annual cap $75k, initial month ~9k.

Two asks:
1) Can finance/PO team issue a temporary procurement reference (serial-style) we use to tag provisioning? If yes, what format do you prefer?
2) Please confirm whether the SKU lines in their CSV map to our billable categories (compute-hours -> compute, embedding-units -> embeddings, support-tier -> professional-services). There are a few combined lines in the CSV that might require splitting.

If you prefer, I can ask Samantha to re-send a SKU-level XLSX.

-Karthik
Head of Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: Gridly Inc. – initial forms and line-item breakdown

Thanks Karthik — quick review: 

- Spend cap: $75,000 seems reasonable for a pilot-friendly provisioning, but need finance sign-off for the initial provisional reference.
- CSV: there are three aggregate lines that must be split to match our ledgers: compute-hours (should be separated into standard/gpu), embedding-units (quantize by model family), support-tier (clarify hours vs. retainer).

Laura — can you confirm temporary reference format and whether we can grant an interim authorization limited to $12,000 for the first 30 days while contract is completed? Ben, we'll need vendor activation intake to ensure tax forms are in our vault before provisioning.

Next steps proposed:
- Karthik asks vendor for SKU-level XLSX with unit prices and a column for cost center mapping.
- Laura to confirm provisional procurement reference syntax and cap for pilot.
- Ben to confirm vendor activation checklist state.

-Monica
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Monica / Karthik — thanks for the quick review. Attached is a cleaned SKU workbook that maps to your categories (onboarding_form_v2.pdf, sku_breakdown.xlsx). Key clarifications: 

- compute-hours: split into standard-cpu (line 1) and gpu-accelerated (line 2). GPU estimates are conservative.
- embedding-units: listed per model family (small, med, large) — we added a column "redwood_bill_code" to help mapping.
- support-tier: clarified as "retainer: 40 hours / month" with an hourly rate line and retainer line separated.

We also attached a signed W-9 and can route tax docs to your vendor portal (Ben, please advise upload location).

Attachments:
- onboarding_form_v2.pdf
- sku_breakdown.xlsx
- w9_gridly_signed.pdf (attached to portal)

If you can provide the provisional procurement reference and confirm an initial authorization up to $12,000, we can provision sandbox access tomorrow.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Vendor Ops | Gridly Inc.

Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding: Gridly Inc. – procurement reference issued (PR-2026-8749)

Hi team — reviewed attachments and vendor portal status. Finance approves a provisional procurement reference with the following controls: 

Procurement Reference: PR-2026-8749 (temporary)
Scope: sandbox/provisioning only — not a budget release for production spend
Initial provisional authorization: $12,000 (30-day window)
Annual spend cap (requested): set at $75,000 — will be enforced at billing time and requires escalation to Finance for increases

Line item corrections accepted:
- compute-hours split accepted (standard-cpu / gpu-accelerated)
- embedding-units mapped to our bill codes (we will accept Gridly's "redwood_bill_code" column for initial mapping)
- support-tier: record retainer as professional-services retainer, cap at 40 hours / month; any overage requires a PO amendment

Attachments validated: onboarding_form_v2.pdf, sku_breakdown.xlsx, w9_gridly_signed.pdf (uploaded to vendor portal). 

Operational notes: 
- Ben: please complete vendor activation in the portal and confirm tax form upload.
- Karthik: you may use PR-2026-8749 as the provisional serial for sandbox provisioning. Please add a note in PROC-4567 when provisioning completes.

Laura Bennett
